body_text:
In a monoid, powers of an element are defined recursively by
$a^0=e$ and $a^{n+1}=a^n a$. Associativity implies
$a^{m+n}=a^m a^n$ and $(a^m)^n=a^{mn}$. These formulas require no
commutativity because all factors are powers of the same element.
